title: coll/{kind}/{cid|default}/name payload
description: UPSERT payload of coll/{kind}/{cid|default}/name. A user collection exists while this is live; for {kind}/default it only renames the implicit collection, and a DELETE restores the default label. Serialized, at most 733 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it, under the Push cap MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (65,536).

name.description: 1 to 100 Unicode code points. Private to the user: never logged.

edited_at.description: When the user made the edit, in the device's local time with its offset (at most ±18:00). Display only; never compared, never restamped.

tz.description: The device's IANA time zone at edit time, e.g. America/Chicago. Display only.
